title: Cosmic Head Revelation
description: A surreal painting depicts a large white bald head with an open mouth emerging from a vibrant cosmic background. The head is positioned in front of a glowing blue and white circular stained-glass spiral, with a radiant sun above, dark rocky mountains below, and orange flowers at the base.
